# S.H.E. Studio V4 — Phase 3 Visual Builder

This upgrade keeps the Phase 2 multi-site dashboard and adds the next visual-builder foundation.

## New in Phase 3

- Section library: Hero, About, Services, Testimonials, FAQ, CTA, Gallery, and Blank
- Layers panel for selecting page structure
- Developer Code panel for editing the full page HTML
- Drag-to-reorder top-level page sections in the preview
- Expanded Flexbox and Grid design controls
- Keyboard shortcuts for Save, Undo, Redo, Duplicate, and Delete
- Automatic layer/code refresh after visual changes
- Existing media library, drafts, GitHub publishing, responsive preview, and multi-site dashboard remain available

## Install

Copy everything inside `she_social_studio_phase3` into the root of the current website repository, replacing matching files. Commit and push, then run a Netlify clear-cache deployment.

No new SQL migration or environment variable is required when upgrading from Phase 2.

## Keyboard shortcuts

- Ctrl/Cmd + S: Save draft
- Ctrl/Cmd + Z: Undo
- Ctrl/Cmd + Y: Redo
- Ctrl/Cmd + D: Duplicate selected element
- Delete: Delete selected element
